profile.name: Noman
profile.bio:
Android Engineer with 4+ years of experience building and shipping production applications using Kotlin, Jetpack
Compose, and MVVM/Clean Architecture. Currently serving as Software Engineer Lead at Envobyte, leading a team
of 5 engineers and overseeing architecture, code reviews, and release processes. Experienced in developing enterprise
and consumer applications, with additional backend development experience using NestJS and TypeScript.

projects.title: Automatic Background Remover
projects.description: Removes image backgrounds automatically with high accuracy, replacing manual masking. Supports batch processing of multiple images plus in-app editing tools.

projects.title: TTBoost
projects.description: Boost your TikTok presence by gaining more likes and followers organically. TTBoost helps creators grow their audience through real engagement, making it easier to increase visibility and reach on TikTok.

projects.title: Image Compressor & Resizer
projects.description: Compress images without losing visible quality. Easily reduce photo size, resize images to fit your needs, convert images to PDF, and optimize photos for sharing, storage, or uploading online.

projects.title: OCR Image to Text Scanner
projects.description: Scan images and convert them into PDFs while extracting text quickly and accurately. Easily digitize documents, copy text from photos, and save important information in seconds.

projects.title: Video Resizer & Compressor
projects.description: A powerful video resizer and compressor that helps reduce video size without noticeable quality loss. Easily resize videos to fit popular social media platforms, save storage space, and prepare large videos for faster online sharing.

projects.title: AWAZ
projects.description: AWAZ is an all-in-one digital platform designed to connect users with useful services, features, and industry-related content in a single app. It creates a seamless digital experience by bridging people with modern digital solutions.
